title: Kelleran Beq
subtitle: Jedi
description: During Darth Vader's siege on the Jedi Temple, many younglings and Jedi were killed. As the 501st clone trooper division encroached upon the Temple, Kelleran Beq was able to free a trapped Grogu and allowed the little one to escape. Beq escorted Grogu through the hazardous Coruscant skies until the pair were able to blast away to safety.
